title: Go-to-market and growth
description: Choose the go-to-market motion that fits your buyer, land your first ten paying customers through founder-led sales, and find the one or two channels and loops that can carry your growth.
objectives: Choose a go-to-market motion (founder-led sales, product-led growth or enterprise) and justify it with your buyer, price point and sales cycle
Map your beachhead on the technology adoption life cycle and define the whole product your early majority customers need
Build a founder-led sales pipeline with clear stages, exit criteria and weekly numbers
Run a discovery call, design a paid pilot with success criteria, and close it into a contract
Use the Bullseye framework to test at least three channels with small, cheap experiments
Describe one growth loop for your product and the metric that shows whether it is working
resources: Enterprise Sales for Founders (Pete Koomen, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/LF-enterprise-sales-for-founders
How to Get Your First 10 Customers (Max Kolysh, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/SF-how-to-get-your-first-10-customers
The Sales Playbook for Founders (Tom Blomfield, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/Mo-the-sales-playbook-for-founders
Do Things That Don't Scale (Paul Graham) — https://paulgraham.com/ds.html
Growth Loops are the New Funnels (Reforge) — https://www.reforge.com/blog/growth-loops

es.title: Go-to-market y crecimiento
es.description: Elige el modelo de go-to-market que se ajusta a tu comprador, consigue tus primeros diez clientes de pago con ventas lideradas por los fundadores y encuentra uno o dos canales y loops que puedan sostener tu crecimiento.
objectives: Elegir un modelo de go-to-market (ventas lideradas por fundadores, crecimiento liderado por el producto o enterprise) y justificarlo con tu comprador, tu precio y tu ciclo de venta
Ubicar tu mercado inicial en el ciclo de adopción de tecnología y definir el producto completo que necesita la mayoría temprana
Construir un pipeline de ventas liderado por fundadores con etapas claras, criterios de salida y números semanales
Conducir una llamada de descubrimiento, diseñar un piloto pagado con criterios de éxito y cerrarlo en un contrato
Usar el marco Bullseye para probar al menos tres canales con experimentos pequeños y baratos
Describir un loop de crecimiento para tu producto y la métrica que muestra si funciona
resources: Enterprise Sales for Founders (Pete Koomen, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/LF-enterprise-sales-for-founders
Cómo conseguir tus primeros 10 clientes (Max Kolysh, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/SF-how-to-get-your-first-10-customers
El manual de ventas para fundadores (Tom Blomfield, YC Startup School) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/Mo-the-sales-playbook-for-founders
Haz cosas que no escalan (Paul Graham) — https://paulgraham.com/ds.html
Los loops de crecimiento son los nuevos embudos (Reforge) — https://www.reforge.com/blog/growth-loops
